capsuleTopic.title: Demons
capsuleTopic.subtitle: action · recognition · authority · accusation · worship · teaching
capsuleTopic.orientation: Trace where Scripture names demons, what these agents do or say, and how each source keeps demons distinct from nearby claims about spirits, illness, idols, Satan, or angels.
capsuleTopic.trailPrompt: Follow the named agents, people, places, commands, accusations, acts of worship, teachings, and outcomes without adding an origin story the sources do not give.
